sanskrit: devīṃ namāmyapaṭaṭaṅkamayapratiṣṭhāmyathānvitaḥ svānubhavāviluptaḥmithyāvikalpajanitau kila bandhamokṣausarvottamottamatamo hi tato mahārthaḥnityāviluptavibhavo gurusampradāyaḥhṛdi parimṛśya nidhīyate mahadbhiḥsvānandāmṛtarūpaṃ jīvanmukteḥ prakalpate viśvamsūkṣmekṣikāprakāro vilasati tasyātiśaktipātasyaanupāyayogayuktyā gurumukhadṛṣṭena sampradāyenatasya svabhāvavilasadviśvamayasya svarūpakiraṇasyamahārthasya parā niṣṭhā galitasvaparasthiteḥgītaṃ purāṇādhiṣṭhānaṃ bhāṣayātu (-tat) taduttamam (tū-)anupāyakramaḥ so'yaṃ yasya rūḍhaḥ sa (rūḍhasya) yogirāṭsthitaye svasvarūpasya nānyat kiñcidapekṣateyā citistanmayasparśāt (cita-) parānandacamatkṛtiḥ (-teḥ)pīṭhakramādau sarvatra viśuddhistasya jāyatesthitināśau svabhāvasya svarūpe ca vilepanamparānandacamatkāracandrikācchāntacetasaḥguruprasādād yajjñānaṃ * * * * kilocyatekathanādikramātītā viśuddhistatra kāśatedṛṣṭādṛṣṭādisaṅketakathāmātrā prakāśatepratyekaviṣayāvṛttyā bahirantarmukhodayāḥtāsāṃ pūjanavicchittyā svarūpaṃ samprakāśateprathate kasyacijjñānamanapekṣitasādhanamprathate kasyacijjñānaṃ saṅketādikathāśrayāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00034 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vikalpasāmanantaryānnirvikalpaḥ pravartateatimātrādibhedena tato'yamuditaḥ (-mucitaḥ) kramaḥśaktipātakramo yo'yaṃ mahātīvratamādikaḥmahānayakrame pūrvaṃ mahāśabdo'rthayuktibhāk (uhāśabdo-)sarahasyapraprañceṣu svarūpasthitihetuṣusthiteṣvapi ca sollekho vyāpako hi mahānayaḥasti nānyā gatisteṣāṃ vikalpagrāsasāhasātsaṅketādikathāmātraṃ tathā cakraprapūjanamtat prapañcitamanyatra yadataḥ sāmprataṃ manāksamyak * * * * * * * navaśādasmābhirunmīlyatepīṭhakramasvarūpaṃ natvā santanyate prathamampīṭhakramasya saṃsthānaṃ kathyate hṛdayaṅgamamyāgādikramarūpeṇa rajjñaptirguruṇocyateataḥ pīṭhakramajñaptistanmukhenaiva kathyateguruṇā sampradāyasya bhājanaṃ kriyate paśuḥpīṭhakramo'tra pīṭhebhyo vyomeśvaryādayaḥ kramātkāyo yaśca jaḍatvena bāhyena viṣayātmanāanantānubhavādhārasiddhayoginiṣevitaḥdṛśyante prakaṭaṃ yasmādasau pīṭhakrastataḥudyogādikramaḥ kāye bahiḥ pṛthvyādyanukramātāśrayāśrayibhāvaścāpyavibhinnatayā sthitaḥpīṭhasvarūpe (-rūpaṃ) vyomeśi viśrāntiḥ sarvasaṃvidāmyaḥ karmendriyaparyantaḥ saṃvitsphārastadāśrayaḥetasyaivāśrayatvena nabhaḥ pīṭhakalā bahiḥkāladāhaikabhūḥ saiṣā śmaśānaṃ khecarī matā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00034 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kālaṃ grasati dehāntaḥ śmaśānaṃ sa tathā smṛtaḥkālagrasanaśīlatvāt tvak śmaśānaṃ tu sā bahiḥpālaye * * * * bhyāṃ bhūpari kṣetrapastataḥkṣetraṃ pālayate tena kṣetreśaścaiva (-śavasyai) tanmayaḥkṣetraṃ pālayate tena tadātmatvena saiva tatsāmarasyātmanā saiṣā melaḥ saṃhārabhakṣiṇīsāmarasyātmanā saiṣā pratyāvṛttyā samantataḥviṣayābhogasambhūtacamatkāropabṛṃhitambījabhāvātmanā melaḥ snigdho yaḥ pratyagātmanāsāmyāntararasāsvādamelāvātmānubhūyateāhanyamāne rabhasāt paratarpaṇahetutaḥnirāvaraṇadurllakṣyasvaviśrāntipadonmukhī(m?)raudraraudreśvarī yāgastasmādiṣṭo gurūttamaiḥadhikapriyamelāvāddhaṭhamelopalakṣaṇaḥtatkṣaṇe vismṛtisteṣāmākāṅkṣāyāḥ parikṣayātatrānuguṇyametasyā devyāḥ sañcetyate sphuṭamsa yāgo yatra bhāvānāṃ viśrāntiḥ samanantarampīṭhakrameṇa saṃśritya devīcakraṃ vijṛmbhatesarvādyantapratiṣṭhānādetat sarvottamatvataḥprakarṣanutimātratvāt pīṭhaṃ praṇavasaṃjñitamatrāntarnetranāthasya prakaṭānubhavo'bhavat (n)yoginīsiddhasaṃsevyamuttarasyāṃ diśi sthitamsarvajñānāśrayatvena lokayātrāpratiṣṭhitamsaṃviddevyo vyāptisārāstaddhāma parikīrtitamprameyalocanādagre sā svayaṃ vinivartate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00034 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mithyāvikalpajanitaṃ bhavamokṣajālamiti śrīmahānayaprakāśe pīṭhasvarūpanirūpaṇaṃ nāma dvitīyollāsaḥākuñcanaprasāraṇavaśato (-kāraṇavaśato) yatrāsti tatpadaṃ natvāprātītikasvarūpaṃ brūmo vyomeśvarīcakramā mūlāt tasya saṃsthānaṃ kathyate saṃvidātmanā (-vidunmanā)na śakyaṃ tadapahnotuṃ svasaṃvedanasiddhitaḥjñānātmatāṃ vinā yasmād bāhyatāpi na sidhyatisaṃvedanaṃ pṛthak tasya (* *) sarvajñenāpi duṣkaramjñānādhikatvāt siddhestu na māyā nāpi vāsanākalpyaviśvātmakatve'pi (katpa-) taduttīrṇatayā sthitamtaduttīrṇasvarūpāyāstasyā nānubhavastadānirāvaraṇarūpāyāścito viśvātmatā kutaḥnīlaprakāro naiva syādātmasaṃvitprathābalāt (syādāddha-)nīlābhinnaprathāsiddhā nīlatāpyanubhūyateprathābahiṣṭve'pyeṣaiva nyāyoktiryadataḥ pṛthaknatu śuddhasvarūpāyāḥ prathāyā eva jṛmbhaṇātprakāśa eva viśvaṃ tu sarvānubhavavāsitamyadataḥ svapratho'pyeṣa siddho viśvaniyantritaḥsañcetyate samāviśya viśvānubhavabhūmikāmnirvikalpaparāhantāsvarūpā prathate prathāviśeṣānubhavo nāsti vivādo'ntarbahiṣṭhayāantarmukhaprakāśo yaḥ parāhantātmakaḥ sthitaḥanyathā nīlasaṃvittirapi naiva prasidhyatiābhāso'pi kathaṃ sidhyet kila saṃvedanaṃ vināābhāsanirapekṣātra draṣṭavyā saṃvidaḥ sthitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00034 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nīlānubhavasaṃsiddhiṃ na samarthayituṃ kṣamesiddhe rūpe svatantratvaṃ samaṃ nīlaprakāśayoḥsvayamprathanaśīlatvānnīlamātmanyapekṣateparatantrasvatantratve tatrākiñcitkare kathamprakāśāpekṣayā (prakāśayāpe-) hyaktaṃ paratantraṃ na rūpataḥprakāśastu prathāmātrādatirikto na vidyatenīlātmani tu nīlasya prathāpekṣāsti (prathākepakṣāsti) sarvathāna prakāśātmakamapi prāyaśo'ndhādidarśanātyathānubhavasaṃsiddhau sarvāpekṣā nivartateprakāśastūpalambhārthaṃ nīlamātmanyapekṣateābhāsarahitā yasmānnaitasyotpattiriṣyatetasya svarūpasattārthaṃ nīlāpekṣā kathaṃ bhavetnīlāpekṣā na tatrāsti svasphurattvena saṃvidaḥtadetaddhi svatantratvaṃ paratantratvalakṣaṇamprakāśasya nijaṃ rūpamathavāpyubhayātmakamubhayāsiddhito rūpaṃ sidhyet sopādhikaṃ kathamparasyāparaniṣṭhatvādevaṃ duṣyejjagatsthitiḥtathā sarvaṃ samīcīnamiti cet tarhicetya (-captya)tāmsvasaṃvedanarūpāyāṃ nirvikalpabhuvi sthitamnacānupādhirūpasya nīlāṃśatvena vedanampratyakṣabhedaḥ kathito yaḥ svasaṃvedanātmakaḥnanu raktodakanyāyād (-yo) bhavato'pi smṛtiḥ kathamvikalpastu svaśilpena tadbhinatti (tadbhunarti) viśeṣataḥvikalpaśilpatastatra kevalaṃ khaṇḍanaṃ sthitamkāryasya tādṛśasyaiva prabandhena pravartanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00034 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sambhaveyuḥ kathaṃ tatra nirvikalpapratiṣṭhitauvirodhāt tāvadekatvaṃ syājjaḍājaḍayoḥ kathamsāṅgaścānyaprathādhīno'pyabhyāsastāttviko [-bhāsastāttviko] mataḥekānekasvabhāvatvāt svabhāvo na nirudhyatetat svasiddhaprakāśo'nyavya (-śo'nyadvaya)vasthāhetutāmiyāttato raktodakanyāyo'saṅgato'tra kathaṃ bhavetābhāsavigamādacchānmuktibhūtā prathā bhavet* * * * * * * * māyābhāsapratiṣṭhiteḥprakāśavigame'pi syād yaddhetorvāsanākṣayaḥnasvaprāptāsya (?) vikalasvahetoravirāmataḥna tat sarvajñatābījaṃ yuktitaḥ paryavasyatitādātmye'pi kathaṃ nāma pratiṣṭhāmadhigacchatitadupādhiṃ prati kathaṃ mātrayāpi prasarpatipratītibhājanaṃ yadvanmaṇiraupyādikairalamprakāśārthoparakto'pi sphaṭikādi jālomapam(?) [jaḍopamaḥ]apahnotuṃ kathaṃ śakyaḥ paratantramaya(ḥ?)prathaḥbhāsate cādhikañceti parasparamasaṅgatamevañca nānānubhavamayī naśyejjagatsthitiḥ* * * * * * * * tatra tvitthaṃ samarthanāanavacchinnarūpatvaṃ tadā tasya nijaṃ praticidullekhādanadhikaṃ lokayātrāprasādhakamiyaṃ sā vastunaḥ siddhistāttvikī viduṣāṃ matāsvollekhakartṛtāsārā pratyakṣānubhavāt sthitāsvatantratvādanunbhagnamunmagnamiva bhāsayetsāmarasyena sarvatra sthitaṃcinmātrasārataḥ (sthitaści-)
source_edition: Muktabodha M00034 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadātmavartini jñāne bhedaḥ syāt tatprathā kathamnavāṃśāṃśikayā bheda ābhāse'pyanubhūyateataḥ prathaikarūpatvamābhāsasya (praśethaka-) vyavasthitamtatprapañco vibhinno'pi tadrūpaṃ jñātumakṣamaḥ (jñe-)tathātvānubhavāsiddheḥ samaṃ tatprathanaṃ kathamtanniyantraṇayā cāsyā ekatvaṃ parihīyateakhaṇḍānubhavātmatvāt sāmarasyatayā sthitāidaṃ tad durghaṭaiśvaryamasāmānyasvabhāvakamanyāvaṣṭambhato'nyasya prathanaṃ bhrāntiriṣyatesvasaṃvedanasiddhatvaṃ na kathañcana bādhitamnanu dvicandrānubhave prathāmātraikajīvitetadekamayarūpatvād bhaved bhādhāpi bādhitāsaṃviddevī jagaccitraṃ nirmimīte svabhittikamyadasatyādikalanāvaśād viśvasya sambhavaḥyatharddhi prātiryādi(?)gambhīrodārasaṃvidaḥphenavat saṃvidudbuddhaṃ tatsāmarthyād vijṛmbhateprameyajātamakhilaṃ sthitaṃ śakyasamarthanammahānayasyānuguṇaṃ cidrūpaṃ pratipāditamato viramyate'smābhirdiṅmātraṃ tu prakāśitamtatrāpi tāsāṃ vaicitryaṃ savikalpāvikalpataḥjñānajñeyaprapañcaśca tatrāpi bahubhūmikaḥtatrāpi svarganarakādyanantamativibhramāḥ (-nativi-)anantalokasaṃsthāna (ḥ?) prabhavāśca tathāvidhāḥāśyānasaṃvidaṃśasya (ādyā-) tadetat sphūrjitaṃ matamsvacchaikarūpasvacchandacidrasāśyānatāmayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00034 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anantāgādhagambhīre saṃvidrūpe nimajjatiastināstivyatikrāntaṃ sarvāśrayanirāśrayamparāṃ śaktiṃ vinā tasya sthitasyāpi svabhāvataḥasatkalpatvamityasya (asaṅkalpa *-) tadapekṣitvamiṣyatetasyā - api parāvasthābhāti (-yāti) sūkṣmaprabhedataḥbhāvābhāvau prakāśe'ntaḥ pratiṣṭhāmadhigacchataḥtāratamyādikalanāvāsanāvedhadūrageparaprakāśaviśrāntidaśāyāmapi yat sthitāḥatastāmasanīkṛtya yā viśrāntiranuttarāyatrāpaṭe parikṣīṇo'pi (parikṣīṇā-) ṭaṅko'sau nayastataḥyā tu viśrāntiviśrāntistaddevīrūpamiṣyateaikye'pi darśitaṃ samyak pratītipariśuddhayeviśvasyeti kathaṃ pūrvamutpattiriti saṃśayam (-ye)nirāvaraṇacitsindhau (-ddhau) sphurattāsārasundaramtaddevīrūpamatrāntaḥ prathamaspandanātmanāsarvāpekṣāvirahitaṃ svoccalattāsvarūpakamtanmayaṃ ca taduttīrṇaṃ vyāpakatvena vartatekhecaryādisvarūpaṃ yat tadasyā - eva jṛmbhitamsvātantryollāsakodrekaprādhānyāt pṛthagucyatepratyekaṃ sūkṣmayā vṛttyā svaucityenānubhūyatesāmarasyātmanā sarvaṃ devīcakraṃ prakāśatepañcākāśatayā pūrvaṃ taduktaṃ saṃvidātmanāparaviśrāntiviśrāntiprādhānyāt tvidamiṣyatesarvakartṛtvamityetat śaktipañcakalakṣaṇamjñānādhikatvāt siddhestu sa tu cinmātralakṣaṇaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00034 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paśvātmakena sphuritaṃ paraśaktisvabhāvataḥcakrapañcakaviṣphāro vyomeśyādimayaḥ sthitaḥtat tat pratītivaicitryavibhāgapratipādanātsāmarasyātmanā pūrvaṃ vyomeśīcakramucyateparasvarūpaviśrāntisamāveśanatatparampūjanena tu saṃrūḍhirataḥ pūjyatamaṃ hi tatādyantavarjitapadaṃ paramātmaniṣṭhāḥjñātvā svayuktigarbhaṃ prakāśacakrakramaṃ tanumaḥjñānakriyātmakatvena pratyekaṃ tad dvidhā matamdaśadhāpyāptisāratvāt tayorapi parisphuṭamevaṃ dvādaśakaṃ yatra prakāśakalilātmakamprakāśacakrapūjyaṃ * * * dvādaśadhā sthitamprakāśamātraprādhānyādanvarthaṃ nāmataḥ sthitamavadhānadhanairjñeyā (-naivyeyā) dvādaśātmāvaśuddhayedeśakālakriyārūpakalāsṛṣṭilayāvaniḥkālakramo bahistattadbhāvabhāvakasaṃvṛtaḥbahirmukhāsvahaṅkāro nilīno'tra vyavasthitaḥcarantyā eva viṣphāraḥ khecaryā dvādaśātmanātadākāramayatvena (ā *-) pūrvaṃ viśvasya sambhavaḥjñānakriyāsāmarasyāt (syaṃ-) kiñcidudrekalakṣaṇaḥkālakramasya sahasā grāso bhavati yogināmjñāninaḥ svasvarūpasya viṣphārastaistu tanyatesa evaṃ sanniviṣṭāntat(?)grāsena sahasāvaniḥparamasamādhimatāmatandritaṃ syātnānandacakramadhunā tadidaṃ pravacmaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00034 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viṣayābhogavibhavā prasṛtecchāsya pūryate (prapūryate)pañcātmakaṃ yadviṣayasvarūpamanubhūyate (yadviṣaya * rūpa)viṣayābhoganirjñātanirvikalpapratiṣṭhiteṣoḍaśātmā sa sañjāto viṣayābhogapūraṇātcinmarīcicamatkāraprameyollekhadanturamsvātmano durghaṭaiśvaryapratipādanalakṣaṇammahānandapradhānatvāccakramānandasaṃjñitamviṣayā eva eteṣāṃ bhavet saṃvitsvarūpabhūḥcarvaṇātmāpi saṃhāro nāntarīyatayoditaḥviṣayābhoga autsukyaṃ marīcīnāṃ nivartatecarantyā eva viṣphāro bhūmayyāḥ ṣoḍaśātmakaḥsamādhilābhāya sadaiva bhūyād bhāvopabhogena mahājanasyadhyātvā samprati mūrticakramucitaṃ vyā *? nyate (yuktibhiḥ)viśrāntiruditā (-cirā) tasya pratyāvṛttyā pramātariahaṅkārasya sakalaprayogārthadaśātmanaḥavyaktarūpo'haṅkāraḥ sa mūrto'tra sphuṭaṃ sthitaḥkālasṛṣṭimayaḥ sphāro (sphurā) marīcīnāṃ cidutkaṭaḥbahirmukhe vā yadataḥ kālakāmātmakaṃ jagatviṣayābhogaviṣphāraviṣaṇṇāsu marīciṣusaptadaśaḥ (-śa) ṣoḍaśānāṃ marīcīnāṃ vināyakaḥsaptadaśātma tadidaṃ mūrticakraṃ vimṛśyatāmtattatpratītivaicitryavāsanālayabhūmigamidānīṃ sa samāpanno mātṛmelāvabhājanam [-melāpa-]etad dvayaṃ yatra līnaṃ sāmarasyena vartateāvāsanena (ava-) sahasā mūrticakre'nubhūyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00034 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: iti viśvakrame hetū kālakāmau na tāttvikaukalanātmakatāvarjyaṃ kathaṃ kāmasya sambhavaḥakālakalitād rūpādakāmācca samutthitautad viśvagrāsarasikaṃ svarūpaṃ parameśituḥbāhyaṃ dadāha śikhināṃ sthūlarūpadharo haraḥpratyāvṛttyā sa evāntaḥ saṃhartā kālakāmayoḥcakraṃ saptadaśamayakramamelapasundaramnāmasaṃsthānayorbhedaṃ prati cakraṃ pravartatenirmeyayogataḥ śakteryoginītvena sambhavaḥsarvaṃ sabhayabhīrutvānnaikatraiva prakāśyatehastāmalakavat teṣāṃ vastutattvaṃ prakāśategurudṛkpātapātrāṇāṃ saṃśayatrāsavicchidekhacakrāt prasṛtaṃ viśvaṃ paraśaktisvabhāvataḥsaṃvit stotraiḥ samālokapramāṇārthapramātṛtaḥ (-tṛdaḥ)devyāḥ saṃhārabhakṣiṇyāḥ sphāra eṣa susaṅgataḥsaṃvidatra paramārthayogināṃ bhāsatāmasamasāhasāvaniḥudayādimayaṃ (-mayā) yadantare haṭhapākena galatyanāratamtadidaṃ samudāyapūrvakaṃ kila vṛndakramacakramucyatepīṭhakramadṛśā pūrvaṃ guruṇā pratipāditamkhacakrātmatayonmagnaḥ pañcātmātha prakāśitaḥpramāṇātmā dvādaśadhā tato'pi pratipāditaḥānandākhyaḥ ṣoḍaśadhā prameyātmā nirūpitaḥsvapratiṣṭhatayā sṛṣṭisaṃhārātmā vyavasthitaḥmātuḥ saptadaśasyāsya mūrtatvena samudbhavaḥsiddho'pi yo bahirbhāvaḥ sarvaḥ sarvavidātmakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00034 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tat prakāśaṃ vinā sidhyenna kathañcana kasyacitparasyāparaniṣṭhatvānnatvaikyaṃ cijjaḍātmanoḥsvollekharekhāsaṃsthānaṃ tat svatantraṃ cidātmakamindriyadvārataḥ paścād bhāvābhāsaḥ pravartatetadatra yāvad guruṇā viśvasyodayasaṃsthitiḥataḥ sarvatra cakrāṇāṃ svarūpapratipādanamāraghaṭṭaghaṭīyantranyāyenaitāvataḥ sadāane(ka)kramayogenāpyākṣipte (ane * - -te) * * gocaramśūnyādārabhya dehāntaṃ saṅkocātmā hi yo'grataḥtadatra yāvat saṃsārastattadrūpatayā sthitaḥna bhāvatyāgato muktirnāpi bhāvopabhogataḥanāgrahādāgrahādvā kasyacinnāpi tāttvikīyadapekṣāvaśāt sarvāḥ saṃsāronyā(?) vimuktayaḥsaṅkocadalanābhyāsād vāsanālayabhūmigamvṛndakramasya saṃsthānaṃ kathyate gurvanugrahātviśvasya bhāvaḥ sahasā svasvarūpe vicīyatesadṛśāḥ pratipādyante cārvākādvayavādibhiḥtairjaḍā vipralamyante sadṛśairabhidhāyakaiḥ (-sāyataiḥ)mahānayopadeśena pātyete svaparāvadhaḥsthitaḥ saṅkocasaṃskāraḥ kā kathānyeṣu jantuṣusarvāgrahagrāhavaśājjīvanmuktiḥ prakāśateavikalpavikalpātmasthairyarūpatayā punaḥnānāvidhāgrahagranthivāsanāvedhabṛṃhitaḥ (-jahitaḥ)ataḥ saṃhārarūpo'yaṃ * * * * vinā kathamtasmāt svarūpadārḍhyena sarvāvaraṇabhedinā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00034 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ato viśvasya saṃsthāne yanmukhena yadāgatamviśvaṃ prakāśādhīnatvāt tanmayatvācca vastutaḥtathaiva haṭhapākena pratyāvṛttikramātmanāetasmin vidite samyaṅmuktiḥ saṃsārabhūmitaḥ (-nām)yathāsthitasya viśvasya yathaivānubhave sthiteyathaiva paśyanti viśvaṃ tathaiva parivartateato vimarśarūpo'yaṃ kathanātmā prakāśatemūrticakre hyahaṅkāraḥ pramātrātmā ya utthitaḥbhāvasaṃskārarūpasya raśmivṛndasya sarvataḥnirvikalpavikalpāṃśān bhāvābhāvadvayānugānnirvikalpavikalpāṃśāḥ prāyaḥ saṅkalanāvaśāttatrāpi jñeyasaṃskārābhijñarūpāḥ pratītayaḥanyā - apica tanniṣṭhā haṭhapākaikalampaṭāḥjñātṛbhogasvarūpāṇāṃ marīcīnāṃ kadambakamtacca sphuṭāsphuṭatvena vartate'nubhavādapiāsāṃ sarvapratītīnāṃ paraviśrāntilakṣaṇamsarvottīrṇā sarvamayī sarvasarvātmakaprathāvyapadeśātigā tasyāḥ svasvarūpamayasthiteḥraudreśvaryā ayaṃ sphāraḥ prādhānyena vyavasthitaḥsaṃhārabhakṣiṇīrūpād vyomeśyantaṃ hi yat sthitamnirvibhajya svakaṃ rūpaṃ haṭhapākakriyātmakam (kaḥ?)icchāsaṃskāravirahe kṣīṇā viśrāmyati svataḥeṣā kṛśatanurdevī sarvecchāvilayāvaniḥyāṃ (*) yāṃ (yā) svacakre cakreśī tāṃ tāmāviśya yuktitaḥato vṛndakrame sarvamupādeyatayā sthitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00034 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mudrāmantranirīhādiprameyapratipādanātkathanāt saṃśayacchedaḥ pūjanaṃ paripūrṇatāato'tra sāvadhānena hṛdayena vimṛśyatāmpratyakṣānubhavāt (* * vāt) sarvaṃ svātmā bhavati yogināmviṣayābhogasaṃskārarūpo yaḥ kāmasambhavaḥtadbhogenāpi kālasya tṛpteruparame satitaditthaṃ prathamaḥ kālaḥ kāmaṃ sṛṣṭvā tataḥ kramāttadetad vastutaḥ sarvaṃ marīcīnāṃ vijṛmbhitamtatra kālasya yā sṛṣṭirdvādaśātmā nirūpitātrayodaśātmatāṃ prāptā sā viśrāntipadonmukhīpañcātmikā pañcaṣaṣṭistata etā marīcayaḥcatuṣṣaṣṭimarīcīnāṃ sāmarasyāvasānabhūḥtanmayollāsaparamāhaṅkārānugamūrtayaḥbhāvānubhavabhūmau hi stimitivyantarātmaniyasyā yasyā yatra yatra rūpādāvadhikāritātannilīnatvamanyāsāmityeko'nubhavo nacetabhilāṣastathāhyeṣa prāyaḥ sparśendriyātmakaḥevaṃ vacanamādhuryaṃ tathāṅgaśvāsasaurabhamtaditthaṃ sarvaraśmīnāṃ sarvasarvātmatāmayamsa eṣa paramo vīraḥ parāhaṅkāralakṣaṇaḥādyayāgaṃ samāsādya sāmarasyena vartatecatuṣṣaṣṭimayenāntaḥ śakticakreṇa saṅgataḥgagalanakṣamā tato'pi pariviśrāmavilīnā(?)madhye ca paramāmodacamatkārarasātmikā (para * -)kāndiśīkatvamāyāti paraśaktāvasāvapi (-tsāvapi)
source_edition: Muktabodha M00034 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: calanānmoharūpasya kramaṇāt parasaṃvidaḥuddyotātikramaścāpi (udyogātika *ścāpi) dvaividhyena vyavasthitaḥekastadvyukramātmānyaḥ parākāśapratiṣṭhitaḥkāmasaṃsargatastasya pratyāvṛttyā (+tma)samantataḥviṣayābhoganirjñātanirvikalpe'pi yat sphuṭamantarmukhatve tūddyotād bhāvāmarśakriyātmakātevaṃ bahirmukhābhāvāvasare hyudayādikamtad (*) bahirviśvamāśrityā * * * tha kriyātmanaḥ* * * * samāśritya pūrvaṃ pīṭhakramātmanātato viśvasya saṃsthānamāmūlāt pratipāditamidānīṃ yena rūpeṇa sarvākāraṃ vilīyatesāmarasye pravṛtte'pi jñānamelāpalakṣaṇe (-melāva-)ataḥ kriyāṃ vinā teṣāṃ hi (na) nirharaṇaṃ bhavetalaṃ grāsapravṛttena kriyāveśena tattvataḥraudreśvarīmayaḥ sphāraḥ parānugrahabhūmikaḥnissaṃskāraprakāmātmā parāśaktiḥ pravartatenirāvaraṇatā (-ṇaṃ *) yasmādataḥ sañjāyate sphuṭamsopānakramarūpeṇa catuṣṣaṣṭirnirūpitāḥcidvimarśasvarūpeṇa haṭhapākena gālanamtatra raudreśvarīrūpaṃ prathamaṃ ṣoḍaśātmanaḥnirāvaraṇatāṃ netuṃ pravṛttaṃ cidvimarśataḥ (-kaḥ)ahaṅkāreṇa siddhatvaṃ śritvā tattanmarīcināmāviśya meyasaṃskāracakraṃ tatra pralīyatemānasaṃskāracakrasya pratyāvṛttikramātmanaḥmananatrāṇadharmābhyāṃ mantrasiddhamayātmatām (-nām)
source_edition: Muktabodha M00034 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhūcarīrūpamāviśya kriyate'nubhavātmanāmelāpasiddhatāṃ (melāva-) śritvā kālagrāso hi tanyatetanmātrarūpasaṃskārāstathāntaḥkaraṇatrayamtadvinirharaṇādyuktaṃ śāktamaṣṭātmakaṃ haṭhātsūkṣmekṣitāprakāreṇa paraṃ tanmātrarūpiṇaḥtathaiva cāntaḥkaraṇatrayasaṃskārabhūmigaḥcakrarūpaṃ śāmbhavaṃ * tañcakraṃ kramataḥ sthitambhavanaṃ śāmbhavaṃ tena cakrametat prakīrtitamraudreśīrūpamāviśya kālagrāsādanantaramtadatra sarvasaṃskāracakramakramarūpiṇāsphuṭāsphuṭatvabhinnena meyābhyāsād yathāyathamcatuṣṣaṣṭimayaṃ meyaṃ sarvākāraṃ (-*) rasiṣyate (-syate)prasaṅgādiha tasyāpi svarūpaṃ pratipādyatesvavimarśātmanā trāṇamiṣyate mantralakṣaṇametad dvayaṃ vyāptisāraṃ sphuṭaṃ pratyakṣataḥ sthitamyatparijñānavaśato bhavo bhavati muktibhūḥavibhāgena vartante sarvānubhavabhūmiṣukhecarī ceti mudrāyāḥ pañcātmakatayā sthitiḥkramastasya yathāsaṃkhyametābhiḥ sarvathānvayaḥanyonyāvyabhicāreṇa sāmarasyādabhinnatāyatparijñānavaśataḥ kāyavaṅmanasāśrayamāṇavādisamāveśatrayavyāpakarūpatāyādikarmādikalma(?)trayamakramato layamicchānirharaṇāt sṛṣṭamākālāgni śivāvadhikeṣāñcideva saṅkrāntā mukhānmukhamanukramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00034 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yāṃ vināpi nayasyāsya vailakṣaṇyaṃ na jāyatelipau pātayituṃ śaktyā na samyagvadate manāk (*)pratyakṣānubhavādasyā bhedagrāso hi yatnataḥapaṭāṭaṅkasaṅketāt kāyasaṃsthānataḥ sthitā (-tam)karaṅkānubhavātmatvāt prathamaṃ sākaraṃkiṇī (-rakiṃkiṇī)saṃrabhāt krodhinīrūpamasāvāśritya vartateyathāyathaṃ sambharaṇād bhairavīti prakīrtitāmahāvilayarūpatvāllelihāneti kathyatenirāvaraṇarūpatvāt khecarīrūpamāsthitātarpayitvā jagatkṛtsnaṃ nijasaṃsthānataḥ sthitāvācakātmasvarūpāntaradhyastaṃ mantrarūpataḥavarṇamayavāk kalpa * * kāratayā sthitaḥnijasvarūpaṭaṅkāntapañcamudrātmakaṃ jagatbhedaprapañcopaśamaḥ parāmarśāntakoṭigaḥ (-śaḥ)nirīharūpe viśrāntiḥ paraviśrāntilakṣaṇenirāvaraṇatā yasmāt sthitā tatrāpi vastutaḥnacāpi na sthitau yasmāt pratītipathi vartatesvasaṃvedanasaṃsiddhaṃ tadvadevānayorna kimkeśoṇḍukābhāsasamaṃ tannirāvaraṇaṃ punaḥparāmarśaḥ punardevī parānugrahabhūmikāanayoḥ samatāmeti yoginaḥ prati vastutaḥnirīhātmā saṃvideva prathate'nupayoginaḥaikadhyamanayā bhaṅgyā pratibhāvaṃ vyavasthitamsaṃkrāmaśca (-ñca) nirīhātmā trayamekatayāpyadaḥsaṃvitsaṃsthānamāśrityā (-āśritya) varṇātmājo (-* jo) virājate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00034 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: apaṭāṭaṅkasaṅketāt kevalaṃ na vibhāvyateanukāryānukaraṇasamānapratipattitaḥanye varṇā vibhidyante yathā nāyaṃ punastathāākṣiteḥ śivaparyantaṃ mahāsāmānyalakṣaṇamnirīhātmatayāpyetaddvayaviśrāntilakṣaṇaḥvyutthāne'pi sthitaṃ sākṣāt trayamekatra saṃyamaḥetadrūpāparijñānāt kā na vikṣepabhūmayaḥmukhāgamamlānabhayādudghāṭya pratipāditammarīcimaṇḍalaṃ tanme kṣamyatāṃ gurvanugrahātasyaiva varṇarājasya lipisaṃsthānamanyathāhṛtsaṃviduttharūpāyā varṇāraṇimayātmanaḥadhaḥ kuṇḍalinīsrotomahāvartaphaṇāhateḥpratyāvṛttyā tu yaddhāmameyasaṃharaṇātmanaḥbinduśūnyātmani sthānānnirāvaraṇatā tataḥmuṇḍadaṇḍakramau tena matau jñānakriyātmakaukarmendriyasphāramayo (-dho) daṇḍātmā tu tato'paraḥanyo raudreśvarīsphāramayo viśvavilāpakaḥvyāptisārā sthitā mudrā pañcaprāṇakriyātmikāmahāprabhāvājjāyante yogināmakramodayāḥyogināṃ mukhyaviśrāntiścidānandāya (muddya-) kalpatesūkṣmakramaprabhāvānāmākāro yogināṃ mataḥdhāmavarṇacidaikāgryamasyāpyanubhavasthitamtadā bhogavināśāya tadā kālopi (-vi) kalpyateakramoccārarūpeṇa citprakāśaḥ prakāśateadūraviprakarṣeṇa sāmānyātmatayā punaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00034 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yathākathañciccakrāṇāṃ granthyādhārakalādibhiḥsvarūpaṃ bodhayantyuccaiḥ te'pi (ke-) na (*) jñānaśālinaḥāṇavatvāt (ana-) prapañcasya nāsmābhiste prapañcitāḥsvānandāmṛtarasatṛptaye sa bhūyātsṛṣṭisthitisaṃhārasvarūpaniṣṭhakramaṃ tanumaḥbṛndakramāntaiḥ sphuritaḥ sarvasaṃśayabhedakaḥātmarūpaparijñāne parānugrahakāriṇīvikalpavāsanāviddhaḥ pūjanātmā pravartatenirvikalpe mahāvyomni sā pūjā hyādarālayāsvasaṅkocakalālope nirvikalpaṃ hi pūjanamyonyādipañcarūpeṇa pūjanātmā yataḥ sthitaḥmahāyonisvarūpasya pikāyātmatayoditā (?)pratyāvṛttikramād bhūyaḥ svarūpapadarūpiṇīnijaviśrāntimāpanno divyayonitayoditātannirvikalpatārūpasṛṣṭyātmā pūjanodayaḥatastadātmakatvena sthityātmā pūjanakramaḥpañcākāśasvabhāvasya nirāvaraṇatāmayam (niśā-)khecarībhūcarīrūpaṃ kūrmanāthatayoditamsaṃhārabhakṣiṇīrūpaṃ meṣanāthatayoditamraudraraudreśvarīrūpaṃ śrīmacchandatayoditamadṛṣṭavigrahāviṣṭaṃ vyomeśvaryādipañcakamdevatārūpamāsādya svasvātantryavijṛmbhaṇātbuddhyādyā eṣa saṃhāraḥ pradhānaḥ pūjanakramaḥpūjanātmasvarūpāṇāṃ kramo'yaṃ nirvikalpakaḥkālagrāso bhavennityaṃ nānānubhavabhūmiṣu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00034 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: upadeśataroḥ puṣpaṃ cidāmodamanoharamnirāvaraṇaviśrāntiḥ saṅkramātmā pravartatesṛṣṭisthitisaṃhāracakrāpekṣāṃ na kurvatesṛṣṭyādicakratritayaṃ tanmate naiva pūjyateetat samārūḍhivaśāt prabhāvo hi pravartateāsīdvāmanavīryasya yadviṣṇustambhanādikamātmajñānāt pravartante yathecchamaṇimādayaḥpratyekamasti traividhyamudrekād bheda iṣyatekālagrāsacarūpahārarasikā nandantu yogivrajāḥtat saṅkrāmamanākhyacakramucitairyuktikramairdṛśyatelolībhāvasthitaṃ nityaṃ sarvānubhavabhūmiṣutamāśrityānurūpeṇa prameyaṃ pratipādyateāsaktiḥ sarvajantūnāṃ viśeṣāt kasyacit kvacitupadeśo na sa manāgapi citte prarohatijaradgauriva sasyebhyaḥ sā hi duḥkhena vāryateabhyasūyanti te yasmādupadeśakarāya catatrādhirūḍhirlokasya śraddhāpūrvaṃ prajāyateprathāyā bhāvaparyantaṃ rūpaṃ tad bhidyate kathamsphuraṇādeva vai teṣāṃ gālanaṃ nāpi tāttvikamnacāsti sphuraṇābhāvo (sphura *-) hyanyasyānupalambhataḥtasmāt tattvamatattvaṃ vā na bhāvena vinā bhavethānopādānakalanātantre tvitthaṃ samarthanāetatparijñānamayī jīvanmuktirnigadyatesargāvatārasaṃhāramayirākramya vartatesṛṣṭisthityādibhirbhedaiścaturdhā api tāḥ sthitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00034 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tasya viśrāntirekaiva tato devyastrayodaśa (devyātra-)tāsāmantyā svaviśrāntirmahāvilayabhūḥ parāanākhyamakramamapi kramātmaiva tadāśrayātkālasya sahasā grāsasaṅkramāditthamiṣyate (grā *-)tatra tatra hyanāyāsādanākhyasphuraṇaṃ sthitamacarvito'vabhāsaḥ syāt tadamṛṣṭatayā kathamtatra tatrākramatvena anākhyaṃ prathamaṃ sthitamkālopādheranākramya nāntarīyatayā sthitātadrūpamātrāvaṣṭambhāt paricchinnātmarūpataḥakrameṇa sthitaṃ no cennīlasaṃvinna sidhyatianyonyaparihāreṇa nīlasaṃvinna tad bhavetnaivaṃ kācit pratītiḥ syādvividhāṃśābhabhedataḥsarvānubhavasaṃsiddhau lokayātrā pratiṣṭhitāyathānubhavametasya bhede'nākhyaṃ sphuṭaṃ sthitamādāvakalitollāsastatsambhogastataḥ paramevaṃ mānasvarūpe'pi caturdhā bhedasambhavaḥatra sarvatra viśrāntirekaiva nirupādhikāvikalpavāsanāśūnyaṃ nirvikalpaṃ pravartatekālagrāsapade samyak praviśanti nirāśrayedvīndriyotpattitaścānye viśrāmyanti nirāśrayedṛśyante kālavilaye viśrāntirnirupādhikāprameyabhūmimāśritya kālagrāsaparāḥ sthitāḥkālīśabdaścatasṛṇāṃ devīnāṃ vācakaḥ sthitaḥpravṛttestā (-tā) stamyādivaśāt kālagrāsaḥ (-mayaḥ) sthitaḥteṣāṃ tadāśrayeṇaiva kālagrāso'bhidhīyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00034 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: udrekāt karṣato dṛṣṭaḥ kālagrāsasya sambhavaḥsthairyameti camatkāro vinā viṣayasaṅgatimpramāṇabhūmimāśritya catasraḥ kālikāḥ sthitāḥsthitisṛṣṭyādibhedena caturdhā kālikodayaḥpramātṛrūpamāviśya catasraḥ kālikāḥ sthitāḥdarśanasparśasambhogavirāmodrekatā matāḥstrīmadyamāṃsabhogeṣu camatkārānuvṛttitaḥetat parikarastvanyo bhāvavargo vyavasthitaḥanenaivāśayenaiva parabrahmopalabdhayetaditthaṃ sarvabhāvānāṃ sarvānubhavabhūmiṣusamyagvastuvicāreṇa (samyaga-) bhāvānāmāsvabhāvataḥ (-nāma-)iti siddhamukhāmnāyayuktyā naivāsti vastutaḥsvaviṣphāramayaṃ sarvamidaṃ saṃsthānamātmanaḥtadgrāsasaṃrambhaparā yāśca dvādaśa kālikāḥekaiva cidacidbhogabhoganirbhogalakṣaṇāsavikalpāvikalpānāṃ sarvāsā saṃvidālayaḥacalā spandarahitā sarvaspandopabhoginītathā pūjanasaṅkrāmairupāyairupalakṣitātrayodaśīti yā devī kathyate hyupacārataḥabhidhānāni (-nni) vartante hṛdayaṅgamayuktitaḥkālikākramadṛṣṭatvādupacāreṇa tāḥ sthitāḥkathaṃ mantrasya sadbhāvaḥ sa pratyakṣo'pi vā kathampañcapiṇḍātmako'pi syāt sūkṣmapratyakṣadarśinaḥupacāreṇa tadvṛttikālikā kramagocarāsarvākāṅkṣāvirahitā viśrāntirjāyate parā
